scope: Presentation-only corrections found in live 150-game QA

corrections.summary: Content-driven numeric layout fixes clipping and overlapping controls.
Replace unavailable font glyphs with direction-specific SVG paths.
Separate Euler bridge labels and stack both Dual Shadow Maze boards at narrow widths.
Give the narrow-screen level selector a readable minimum width and its own label row.
Show Chinese words for angle controls without relying on unavailable diagonal-arrow glyphs.
